definitions.explanation: A wide version of the traditional wooden veranda ({縁側|えんがわ}), broad enough to set out a table and chairs. Common in ryokan and Japanese-style guest rooms.

examples.english: To drink tea on the wide veranda.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広縁|ひろえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This room has a wide veranda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広縁|ひろえん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Gazing at the garden from the ryokan's wide veranda is something special.

notes:
A wide ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧ — the wooden veranda strip along a Japanese-style room — broad enough to hold a small table and chairs. Frequently found in ryokan guest rooms as a relaxing spot beside the window.
